title: Zepbound and Mounjaro activate brown fat in obese rats
seoTitle: Zepbound and Mounjaro Activate Brown Fat in Obese Rats
subtitle: Study points to metabolic effect beyond appetite suppression
excerpt: Tirzepatide activated brown fat in obese rats, suggesting a metabolic benefit that could expand treatments for obesity and diabetes.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Tirzepatide, marketed under the names Mounjaro and Zepbound, has shown the ability to activate brown fat—which is responsible for calorie burning—in obese rats.

The finding indicates that the medication may exert an additional metabolic effect alongside its well-known appetite-reducing properties. If the same mechanism is confirmed in humans, it could help explain the robust benefits observed with the use of tirzepatide.

In addition to expanding the understanding of how the drug works, the discovery opens up possibilities for developing more comprehensive approaches to treating obesity and diabetes.

With information from ScienceDaily.
